about_the_game:
Try a small slice of Restore Your Island: heal a smaller island, bond with your dog, and relax by the fireplace — your feedback shapes the full game.

ABOUT THIS DEMO Thanks for trying the Restore Your Island demo! This build is a focused vertical slice of the full game that shows the heart of what we’re making: place-based ecological restoration, companion play, and cozy downtime.

What’s included in the demo

  • A playable smaller island where you can survey damage, clean up debris, and discover easter eggs and treasures hidden beneath the sand.

  • The revival loop: apply fertilizer to weakened trees and observe visible regrowth. Revived trees can drop bananas and coconuts that restore player energy during a session.

  • Core actions: cleaning, petting and playing with your dog, collecting fruit, exploring, and upgrading tools using the in-game money by selling what you collect .

  • Your dog companion: pet them and play the demo mini-game (hide & find). These interactions demonstrate bonding.

  • The fireplace hub: sit by the fire, play the demo music tracks, listen to water ambience, and relax — a preview of features we’ll expand in the full game.

  • English + all available interface/subtitle languages (the full release will support the same multi-language set). Steam Store

What the demo does NOT include (for clarity)

  • This is a limited area slice — full map, house decorations, late-game biomes, and many planned upgrades are not in this demo.

  • Progress made in the demo does not carry over to the full release.

  • Achievements, Trading Card drops, Workshop, and some planned social features are not active in the demo.

Approximate playtime

  • Expect 30–60 minutes to explore the demo area and experience the loop end-to-end. (Your playtime may vary depending on how much you explore and how long you spend at the fireplace.)

What we want you to test / tell us about

  • Can you tell when the island is reacting to your actions? (Is visual feedback clear and satisfying?)

  • Are the dog interactions fun and responsive? Any suggestions for mini-games?

  • Does the fireplace feel like a restful hub? Any ideas for sounds, music, or interactions?

  • Is the energy pacing (fruit rewards → actions) comfortable or too limiting/too generous?

  • Any usability or clarity problems in the UI, or translation/localization issues.

  • Performance, crashes, or graphical glitches on your hardware.

How to report bugs & give feedback (please use Discussions → Bug Reports) When you post a bug or feedback, please include:

  • Platform & OS: (Windows version)

  • GPU / CPU / RAM: (e.g. GTX 1060, i5-8400, 16GB)

  • What happened: (short description)

  • Steps to reproduce: (exact steps you did)

  • Expected result vs what happened:

  • Attach: one screenshot or short video clip if possible.
    We’ll read every report and post ongoing fixes in the Demo → Updates thread.

Known issues (demo)

  • Localization for smaller scripts is in-progress — please report any mistranslations.
    (We’ll update this list with known fixes as we patch the demo.)

Thank you & next steps Thanks for playing — your feedback will directly influence which features and improvements we prioritize for the full release (planned Q4 2025). If you enjoy the demo, please add the full game to your wishlist to follow development and get notified at launch.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-1700 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100 (~3.0 GHz, quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / GTX 1650 or AMD RX 560 / RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X (6–8 cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 / 3070 / 3080 / or AMD RX 6800 / 7900
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Play a hands-on slice of Restore Your Island: clean, save animals, find easter eggs & treasures, revive the land, play with your dog, and relax by your cozy fireplace.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
